description: Probe at d0c490721: a receive whose pattern contains a bitstring (`<<45, 45, r::binary>>`, or one nested in a tuple) panics on run and build: `panicked at runtime/src/ir_runtime.rs:1304: bs_tuple_arity3_schema not set`. interp is correct; receive without a bitstring pattern is fine. Inferred cause, unconfirmed: native_codegen/driver.rs has_bs_prim (:31-43) does not see the receive path's bitstring primitive, so the schemas are not registered. Expected: the receive matches as on interp and as in Elixir on all three paths; covers both spellings, `<<"--", r::binary>>` and `"--" <> r` (fz-sc8.56).
title: A receive with a bitstring pattern runs on the JIT and the native build
